rationale: Several papers, such as 2412.04430, 2105.03003, 2105.09790, 2210.13335, 2403.03484, 2005.12587, and 2102.10100, investigate potential causes for the Hubble constant discrepancies, including dynamical dark energy, baryon inhomogeneities, and modifications to cosmological models. These studies provide substantive evidence on various aspects of the question, but no single resolution is reached.
